therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: protein degradation pathway disruption leading to apoptosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: subjects with relapsed or refractory follicular B-cell lymphoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: response rate to Velcade as a single agent

results.dose_information: Arm A: 1.5 mg/m2 twice weekly for 2 weeks (days 1, 4, 8, 11) in 21-day cycles; Arm B: 1.6 mg/m2 once weekly for 4 weeks (days 1, 8, 15, 22) in 35-day cycles for 6 cycles total

context.investigator_commentary: An arm closed due to lack of efficacy
